Maren Finance

Spend Bitcoin. Never sell it. A money app for Bitcoin, built on Mezo.

Maren is a money app for Bitcoin, built on Mezo. Deposit Bitcoin, borrow MUSD against it from as little as 0.001 BTC, and spend it: pay a @name, send a money link, request money, and put idle MUSD to work.
